job: Prove a claim with three or four large figures and what each one counts.
purpose: Figures in the display face with tabular numerals, each with its unit and a label beneath. row: one ruled row divided by hairlines. grid: two by two, a cross of hairlines. lead: one very large figure with its sentence beside it.
useWhen: Numbers a reader can check: volume, speed, uptime, customers.

avoidWhen.when: A figure that belongs to one quote.

variants.useWhen: Four figures with room around each.
One figure that carries the section.

parts.role: The date or range of a lead figure.

relation.because: Stats tiles report live metrics in the app; this section sets a few public figures large on a marketing page.
